rows.grounds: genitive dependent indicating the target of opposition
conjunction linking items in the enumeration
abstract noun denoting contrariness or hostility
adverb indicating continuation of the same class of acts
past participle qualifying what is appropriated; taken with saṃgrahaḥ
noun denoting taking or seizing of entrusted property

items.question: Which acts against the teacher and entrusted property are condemned as transgressions?
premises: Opposition to the teacher is included in the enumeration of prohibited acts.
Appropriation of deposited property is likewise included as a prohibited act.
These acts continue the preceding list of transgressive conduct.
items.inference: Hostility toward the teacher and misappropriation of entrusted deposits are condemned transgressions.
items.plain_english: And opposition to the teacher, and likewise the appropriation of what has been deposited.
